Āsavaṁ dhammaṁ paṭicca āsavo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā—kāmāsavaṁ paṭicca diṭṭhāsavo avijjāsavo, diṭṭhāsavaṁ paṭicca kāmāsavo avijjāsavo, avijjāsavaṁ paṭicca kāmāsavo diṭṭhāsavo, bhavāsavaṁ paṭicca avijjāsavo, diṭṭhāsavaṁ paṭicca avijjāsavo. (Ekekampi cakkaṁ kātabbaṁ.)
